title: /.well-known/invariant.json
description: What an API provider serves from its own domain at /.well-known/invariant.json: the APIs it publishes and the public keys it signs their releases with. A reader trusts a published bundle only if a key listed here signed it, whoever served the bundle. Readers ignore properties this version does not define, so a later version can add one; a document written for version 1 has none.

version.description: The version of this document's format.

apis.description: The APIs this domain publishes, by the id their bundles carry (a bundle's `api`).

keys.description: Every key that has signed releases for these APIs, including those that no longer sign, so what they signed stays verifiable.

bundles.description: Where this provider's bundles are published, when not the hosted service.

url.description: The service's base URL; bundles are read from <url>/public/v1/apis/<api>/bundles.

timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 time with a zone, such as 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

keyid.description: sha256: and the hex SHA-256 of the key's SPKI DER form: the id a bundle's signature names. It must be the id of public_key.

public_key.description: The Ed25519 public key, PEM encoded (SPKI).

added_at.description: When the key began signing. A bundle published before it is not the key's.

not_after.description: When the key stopped signing. What it signed before stays trusted; a bundle published after it is refused.

revoked.description: The key is withdrawn: nothing it ever signed is trusted, whenever it was published.

revoked_reason.description: Why the key was revoked, shown to whoever a bundle is refused for.

apis.description: The APIs this key signs for, when not every one the document lists.
